newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro takes Q496 writedown on Frigg.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro takes Q496 writedown on Frigg.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Wednesday it would make provisions and write down the carrying value of assets in the North Sea's Frigg area by a total of 600 million crowns, to be booked in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The net result after deferred taxes will be a charge of 132 million crowns, Hydro said in a statement.

Hydro said it had reduced the carrying value of assets in the Lille-Frigg and Froey fields by 400 million crowns. At the same time it had raised provisions for future costs related to workforce reductions, closure and the removal of installations in the Frigg area by 200 million crowns.
Previously Hydro has recorded two other writedowns tied to the Frigg area, one of 755 million crowns in the second quarter of 1995 and a further 400 million crowns in the third quarter of 1996.
Hydro owns 6.05 percent interest in Froey and 32.87 percent in the Lille-Frigg field and in the Norwegian part of the Frigg field.
